title: Empirically designed masonry, glass unit masonry and masonry veneer in buildings in structural occupancy
officialText:
category IV. The minimum inspection program for empirically designed masonry, glass unit masonry and masonry veneer
designed by Section 2109, 2110, or Chapter 14, respectively, or by Chapter 5, 6 or7 of TMS 402/ACI 530/ASCE 5, in structures
classified as structural occupancy category IV, in accordance with Table 1604.5, shall comply with Table 1704.5.1.
